description: T10 (design guidelines §6): holding Tab paints the enemy's threat ranges, releasing it removes them; off by default. ThreatOverlay (/root/Main/BoardRoot/ThreatOverlay) draws, for every enemy unit on the table, its shooting range in MARGINAL_YELLOW (CanvasGroup fill at 15% alpha) and its 12" charge-threat range in INVALID_RED (fill at 10% alpha), both measured base edge to base edge from every alive model like the engine's range checks; each fill layer is one CanvasGroup so overlaps never stack, each unit gets ONE outline (the union of its models' circles: yellow solid, red dashed), and everything is clipped to the board. Melee-only units (the Blade Champion) have no shooting ring (radius_px 0). Fixture co_pretrigger, Shooting phase, hot-seat, P2 (Orks) active: the viewer is P2, the enemy is Player 1's 8 units on the table (the Caladius is in reserves) -> 16 rendered_rings. Player path: the real Tab key through the OS-event pipeline (simulate_key state press / release). In the Shooting phase Tab is also 'cycle shooter' (shoot_cycle_eligible_unit), and ShootingController._input runs before Main's, so it used to swallow the press: it now hands the press to ThreatOverlay.begin_tap_or_hold - held 0.2 s it becomes the threat view (no cycle), a quick tap still cycles the shooter on key-up. Checks: baseline off/empty/hidden; held: Tab down in Input, active, viewer 2, 16 rings == 2 x the enemy count taken from GameState independently, every shoot entry MARGINAL_YELLOW and every charge entry INVALID_RED with one of each per enemy unit, radii = range x 40 px + base extent (Telemon 72", Contemptor 18", Custodian Guard 24", ...), fill alphas 0.15 / 0.10 on CanvasGroups, shooter not cycled; released: inactive, empty, hidden. pixel_diff (framed at x0.62 on the Custodes half): before->held 45.8% full frame (bound > 2.0) and 96.1% of the board region (> 80), right HUD 0.0% (< 0.5), before->after 0.0% (< 0.5). No flicker: three more press/hold/release cycles give exactly one on/off each (activation_count 4), the same three layer nodes, and a fourth hold paints the identical frame (held vs held_again 0.0%, < 0.5); a key-repeat (echo) Tab while held is consumed - focus stays on a focused HUD button and nothing toggles; releasing Tab with Shift down still turns it off. A quick tap cycles the shooter and never shows the overlay. The scripted path (assigning ThreatOverlay.active) builds 16 rings and clears them. After END_SHOOTING (Charge phase) Tab shows the view within two frames (no tap meaning there).

steps.script:
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_rotation = 0.0
m.view_zoom = 0.62
m.view_offset = Vector2(880, 690) - Vector2(930, 575) / 0.62
m.update_view_transform()
return m.view_zoom
steps.comment: Deterministic framing (x0.62): the Custodes half of the board, where every enemy unit and its rings sit.
The phase-change 'Game autosaved' toast must be gone before the baseline (it alone diffs ~1.6%).
Tier A: off by default.
Tier A: nothing rendered at baseline.
No shooter armed at the start (the tap check below needs this).
Player path: hold Tab. In the Shooting phase ShootingController hands the press to ThreatOverlay.begin_tap_or_hold (Tab is also 'cycle shooter'); held past 0.2 s it becomes the threat view.

steps.script:
# The Tab press went through the OS-event pipeline (Input) and is still held.
return Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_TAB)

steps.comment: Tier A: Tab held -> active.
Turned on by the Shooting-phase hold, not by a script.
Tier A: 2 x 8 enemy units (literal from the fixture).
Tier A: rendered_rings.size() == 2 * enemy_unit_count, the count taken from GameState independently.
Tier A: every shoot entry MARGINAL_YELLOW, every charge entry INVALID_RED, one of each per enemy unit.
Holding Tab did not also cycle the shooter.
Tier A: released -> inactive.
Turned off by the Tab key-up event itself.
Tier A: released -> no rings.
Tier A: baseline vs held > 2.0%.
The board is almost entirely washed: the Telemon's 72" guns reach every point of it (measured 96.1%).
The world-space overlay never paints over the right HUD column.
Clipped to the battlefield: the grey margin left of the board stays untouched although the rings extend past the edge.
Tier A: baseline vs released < 0.5% (cleanly removed).
Repeated press/hold/release x3 (Tier B: no flicker).
Still 16 after repeated presses: nothing accumulates.
Every press paints the same frame.
Released while Shift is down: the release still counts (modifier-strict matching used to strand the overlay on).
The Shift+Tab key-up itself turned it off (not the stuck-key fallback in _process).
A quick TAP of Tab in the Shooting phase still cycles the shooter.
Scripted path the task allows: assigning ThreatOverlay.active builds the rings too.
Outside the Shooting phase Tab has no tap meaning: the view shows at once.
Charge phase: on within two frames of the press (no 0.2 s hold wait).
